rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes ICM/TE quality and image limitations, but it questions the reported 3AA expansion stage and mentions possible debris not clearly verifiable from the prompt.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte maturity, endometrial thickness, BMI, endometriosis, sperm parameters, and first-cycle status into prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor tension comes from partially downgrading the image while still accepting the lab grade.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice: supports SET, appropriate luteal support, cautious use of PGT-A, and evaluation of uterine/endometriosis factors. Minor deviations include speculative supplements and broad mention of immune factors.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, pregnancy monitoring, and further evaluation if unsuccessful, though some recommendations remain somewhat general.
